ScreenTamer is a parental-control agent for your own Fire TV devices.

The agent runs as a foreground service with three guard rails keeping it alive: a persistent notification, a boot receiver, and an accessibility watchdog. It tracks screen time on-device, enforces daily limits / curfews / blacklists, and serves a parent dashboard over HTTP on your home network (or via the optional relay server).

Use Test Local ADB to verify the agent can control the TV. The setup script grants the hidden permissions Fire OS hides from the UI.
